description: From the cathedral square, Sankt Knuds Kirke is a red-brick Gothic basilica with one west tower and an open lantern spire. The square is empty under streetlamps. The sky is overcast, about 13.0°C, with no rain. This is the city-centre cathedral, not the low ochre houses of the H.C. Andersen quarter.
